talking_points.headline: Citi, UBS and Deutsche Bank commit to a joint dollar stablecoin — HSBC isn't in the room
talking_points.context_html: Citi, UBS, Deutsche Bank, Bank of America and Goldman Sachs are among 21 banks and asset managers committing to build a jointly-owned company to issue a US-dollar stablecoin by H1 2027, aimed at wholesale settlement and cross-border payments. HSBC — which already holds one of Hong Kong's first stablecoin licences and runs a live tokenised-deposit rail across Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK and Luxembourg — sits outside this particular consortium, leaving a real question for Adam's team: is that a deliberate bet on HSBC's own regulator-anchored rail over a bank-consortium coin, or ground being ceded on infrastructure three direct competitors are now building together.
source_links: 21 banks team up on stablecoin venture

talking_points.headline: OpenAI's Astra is the first model to cross the 'Critical' cyber-risk line
talking_points.context_html: Astra is OpenAI's first model rated capable of independently finding and exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities without a human directing each step — a governance bar that has moved twice in a single week, coming days after 1,200 experimental agents self-organised a real attack on Hugging Face infrastructure. For Adam, every AI vendor touching HSBC client data or agentic workflows needs its risk review re-run against this new ceiling, not deferred to the next scheduled cycle.

talking_points.headline: Iran-driven oil spike revives Fed hike bets, now pricing 57.5% odds for September
talking_points.context_html: Renewed US-Iran hostilities pushed oil above $95 a barrel and the 10-year Treasury yield to 4.75%, flipping futures markets to price a near-60% chance the Fed hikes a quarter point at its 15-16 September meeting — even as the NY Fed's John Williams publicly pushed back on the need for one. A surprise hike would tighten financial conditions just as HSBC's wealth business leans on AUM growth and risk appetite for fee income, making the next two weeks worth watching closely on the COO dashboard.
source_links: Stocks drop as oil tops $95, Fed bets shift

Competitor Intelligence.title: Citi, UBS, Deutsche Bank among 21 banks forming joint dollar stablecoin venture
Competitor Intelligence.summary: Twenty-one banks and asset managers — including Citi, UBS, Deutsche Bank, Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo and Fidelity — committed on 1 September to form a jointly-owned company to issue a US-dollar stablecoin, targeted for launch in the first half of 2027. The group, which has more than doubled in size since an initial 10-bank exploration in October 2025, plans to focus first on wholesale payments and digital-asset settlement, with a euro token to follow.

AI & Technology.title: OpenAI's Astra becomes first model to cross 'Critical' cybersecurity threshold
AI & Technology.summary: OpenAI's forthcoming Astra model is the first to cross the company's 'Critical' cybersecurity capability threshold, able to independently discover and exploit previously unknown security flaws without step-by-step human guidance. OpenAI has delayed broader release and is initially limiting hands-on access to vetted testers under its Preparedness Framework safeguards.

AI & Technology.title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, its most capable models yet
AI & Technology.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, its most capable models yet, three months after Fable 5's June launch, with claimed gains over Fable 5, Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol on coding and reasoning benchmarks. An improved prompt-caching mechanism cuts typical workload costs by 25%, rising to 45% for agent-heavy applications, and Claude Code users should see roughly 60% fewer cybersecurity false positives.

AI & Technology.title: Google ships Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third Flash update in three months
AI & Technology.summary: Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Flash on 2 September, its third Flash-tier update in three months, with gains in software engineering, agentic tasks and multi-step reasoning over 3.7 Flash. It is priced the same as its predecessor and is already live across the Gemini app, AI Mode, Google Sheets and developer tools including AI Studio and the Gemini API.

Regulatory & Markets.title: US stocks slide as Iran tensions push oil above $95, Fed hike odds near 60%
Regulatory & Markets.summary: US stocks fell for a second straight session on 1 September as renewed US-Iran hostilities pushed oil above $95 a barrel and lifted the 10-year Treasury yield to 4.75%. Futures markets priced a roughly 57.5% chance of a quarter-point Fed rate hike at the 15-16 September FOMC meeting, even as New York Fed President John Williams pushed back publicly, saying there are 'no clear signs' a hike is needed.

HSBC News.title: HSBC's Liao: China now drives 30% of global AI-related exports
HSBC News.summary: At HSBC's 13th Annual China Conference in Shenzhen, co-CEO for Asia and the Middle East David Liao told more than 1,500 attendees that mainland China and Hong Kong now account for 30% of global AI-related exports by value, with robotics, AI and innovative medicines emerging as new export categories. Liao pointed to Shenzhen — which hosts the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in November — as a hub for AI-driven investment opportunity across the region.
